id./param/region/r025.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1882: "She's a wonderful innkeeper, cheerful and attentive to detail.
id./param/region/r025.pack|npc_ie.bxon|188c: "To restore Rica, I think having her read a book that teaches what a king should be is the way.
id./param/region/r025.pack|npc_ie.bxon|18b8: "I've been waiting. You found a book on how a king should be, didn't you?
id./param/region/r025.pack|npc_ie.bxon|18c6: "Not yet...? I thought you'd find it by now. It takes longer than I expected.
id./param/region/r025.pack|npc_ie.bxon|18d6: "Thank you! "A True King"... exactly the book I wanted. Let's have Rica read it right away.
id./param/region/r025.pack|npc_ie.bxon|18ed: "Rica regained her pride as innkeeper king, so she'll be fine now.
id./param/region/r025.pack|npc_ie.bxon|18f7: "Bringing back a girl's smile may seem small, but Rica's is a special smile that cheers everyone.
id./param/region/r025.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1906: "If she'd stayed down, Rica's friend might have worried too much to continue the journey.
id./param/region/r025.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1912: "So you cheered not only Rica but many people around her. Remember that. Thank you.
id./param/region/r025.pack|npc_ie.bxon|194c: "I'm worried... This has never happened before...
id./param/region/r025.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1962: "I'm worried about Lady Rica, but it won't help if I'm down too. So then...

id./param/region/r025.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1b04: "I'm glad Lady Rica is well again. It's all thanks to you.
id./param/region/r025.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1b0d: "But why did Lady Rica suddenly slump like that?
id./param/region/r025.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1b2a: "Lady Rica is well again, so I can focus on my work. So then...
id./param/region/r025.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1c5d: "What's wrong with Rica? She's looked gloomy lately, and it brings me down too.
id./param/region/r025.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1c6e: "Hm? What's wrong? ...What, do you know anything about something that can expose a fake?
id./param/region/r025.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1caf: "Hm? What's wrong? ...What, do you know anything about something that can expose a fake?
id./param/region/r025.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1c78: "You're looking for a weird item. ...Come to think of it, an acquaintance said they found an Unmasking herb on their travels.
id./param/region/r025.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1cb8: "You're looking for a weird item. ...Come to think of it, an acquaintance said they found an Unmasking herb on their travels.
id./param/region/r025.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1c86: "That mage friend is in a cave called the Unseen Demon's Path. They're probably around floor B3 now.
id./param/region/r025.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1cc7: "That mage friend is in a cave called the Unseen Demon's Path. They're probably around floor B3 now.
id./param/region/r025.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1c9d: "Rica has such a nice smile. Seeing it fills me with energy to do my best today.
id./param/region/r025.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1ce0: "I came to stay here because I heard it won the Innkeeper King Grand Prix... The receptionist is so gloomy it's awful.
id./param/region/r025.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1cf2: "Was that girl Rica feeling unwell? She's brisk, different from before, and her considerate manner is pleasant to see.
id./param/region/r025.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1d05: "I don't need the Unmasking herb you gave. Give it to someone who truly needs it.
id./param/region/r025.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1d18: "...Hm, are you looking for someone? What, a prince?
id./param/region/r025.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1d2f: "...Hm, are you looking for someone? What, a prince?
id./param/region/r025.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1d1f: "Ah, that guy? He's far away and won't be back for a while.
id./param/region/r025.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1d51: "I just thought, if only I could become the strongest dragon I imagined, Endragon, the Dragon of Ending.
id./param/region/r025.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1d5c: "A sturdy body, big wings, long black horns, three tails...
id./param/region/r025.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1d65: "I daydreamed of becoming that dragon to surprise everyone, found a golden fruit... then I don't remember.
id./param/region/r025.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1d73: "But I feel I got carried away and rampaged. If I caused trouble, sorry.
id./param/region/r025.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1d7e: "...Oh, right! If you go deeper in the cave, be careful! I feel something really dangerous.
id./param/region/r025.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1d9a: "Hmm. This is utterly strange... The Goddess fruit I held vanished... What a pickle. What should I do?
id./param/region/r025.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1da8: "You... can't be human? Why is a human in a place like this...
id./param/region/r025.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1db0: "No, wait. If you were human, you couldn't see me... Am I dreaming?
id./param/region/r025.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1dbd: "Still, why are you here? Do you need something from me?
id./param/region/r025.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1dcc: "...Strange fellow. This is no place for a human to wander in. If you have no business, go home.
id./param/region/r025.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1de4: "You came to solve my problem? Ha ha! I see. You're teasing me.
id./param/region/r025.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1dee: "Well, why not. Let me ask you. A golden fruit called the Goddess fruit suddenly vanished from my hand.
id./param/region/r025.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1dfe: "I probed for traces, but only the words 'unseen fiend' surfaced, and I don't know what they mean.
id./param/region/r025.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1e0d: "I have almost no clues, but if you say you can search, please try! If you find it, I'll reward you well!
id./param/region/r025.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1e26: "A golden fruit called the Goddess fruit suddenly vanished from my hand. Such a disappearance is no ordinary matter.
id./param/region/r025.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1e36: "But it vanished under my watch, so it's my responsibility. The Goddess fruit is a treasure of the angel realm. I must find it!
id./param/region/r025.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1e49: "When I probed for the Goddess fruit's traces, the words 'unseen fiend' surfaced.
id./param/region/r025.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1e55: "I don't know what it means, but it must relate to the fruit's whereabouts. Please look into the unseen fiend too!
id./param/region/r025.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1e6d: "This feeling... Did you find the Goddess fruit?
id./param/region/r025.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1e7c: "I see, not yet... I thought I felt the Goddess fruit's presence...
id./param/region/r025.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1e9d: "Thank you! To think a human would help an angel like me! Here, take your reward.
id./param/region/r025.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1eaa: "Oh? The Goddess fruit that fell to the earth turned a Slime into a fierce dragon? That's certainly possible.
id./param/region/r025.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1eb8: "The Goddess fruit holds immeasurable power. That's why we guard it strictly so monsters can't get it, but...
id./param/region/r025.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1ec9: "This disappearance was too sudden to prevent...
id./param/region/r025.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1ed4: "Perhaps it was the work of someone beyond my power. If you keep traveling, be careful too.
id./param/region/r025.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1f0a: "Perhaps it was the work of someone beyond my power. If you keep traveling, be careful too.
id./param/region/r025.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1eec: "The Goddess fruit holds immeasurable power to grant the wish of whoever eats it.
id./param/region/r025.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1ef9: "We guard it strictly from monsters, but this disappearance was too sudden to prevent...
id./param/region/r025.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1f18: "You resemble my apprentice, who'll inherit Wallo Village's guardian angel post. He's earnest and upright too.
id./param/region/r025.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1f42: "I'm surprised... A human coming to the angel realm. And you seem able to see me.
id./param/region/r025.pack|npc_ie.bxon|227a: "I'm surprised... A human coming to the angel realm. And you seem able to see me.
id./param/region/r025.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1f4f: "Something is happening after all. Human who appeared with the anomaly, please help Aquila.
id./param/region/r025.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2287: "Something is happening after all. Human who appeared with the anomaly, please help Aquila.
id./param/region/r025.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1f68: "...What is it? You seem to have something to say. Hmm... Do I know angel's smelling salts, you ask?
id./param/region/r025.pack|npc_ie.bxon|22a0: "...What is it? You seem to have something to say. Hmm... Do I know angel's smelling salts, you ask?
id./param/region/r025.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1f73: "Of course. It's common for monsters to play pranks and make people lose their senses.
id./param/region/r025.pack|npc_ie.bxon|22ab: "Of course. It's common for monsters to play pranks and make people lose their senses.
id./param/region/r025.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1f7d: "Every angel carries medicine to cure that anytime... What about it?
id./param/region/r025.pack|npc_ie.bxon|22b5: "Every angel carries medicine to cure that anytime... What about it?
id./param/region/r025.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1f88: {var:1} told Ladiel about⏎people opposing a marriage⏎as if they'd lost their senses.
id./param/region/r025.pack|npc_ie.bxon|22bf: {var:1} told Ladiel about⏎people opposing a marriage⏎as if they'd lost their senses.
id./param/region/r025.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1f93: "I see. You came looking for the medicine. If people changed suddenly, this medicine may indeed be needed.
id./param/region/r025.pack|npc_ie.bxon|22cb: "I see. You came looking for the medicine. If people changed suddenly, this medicine may indeed be needed.
id./param/region/r025.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1fa1: "Take it. One bottle can cure about a town's worth of people.
id./param/region/r025.pack|npc_ie.bxon|22d8: "Take it. One bottle can cure about a town's worth of people.
id./param/region/r025.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1fa9: Obtained angel's smelling salts!⏎Deliver them to the woman at the hero's home!
id./param/region/r025.pack|npc_ie.bxon|22e1: Obtained angel's smelling salts!⏎Deliver them to the woman at the hero's home!
id./param/region/r025.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1fbd: "The Goddess fruit has the power to grant the eater's wish. In the wrong hands, it'd be disastrous.
id./param/region/r025.pack|npc_ie.bxon|22f4: "The Goddess fruit has the power to grant the eater's wish. In the wrong hands, it'd be disastrous.
id./param/region/r025.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1fcb: "...Come to think of it, there was word that a fearsome dragon suddenly appeared in a cave on earth.
id./param/region/r025.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2303: "...Come to think of it, there was word that a fearsome dragon suddenly appeared in a cave on earth.
id./param/region/r025.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1fd7: "It may relate to the Goddess fruit Aquila lost. If you can go to that cave on earth, it may be worth a visit.
id./param/region/r025.pack|npc_ie.bxon|230f: "It may relate to the Goddess fruit Aquila lost. If you can go to that cave on earth, it may be worth a visit.
id./param/region/r025.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1fe9: "What! You found the Goddess fruit? That's amazing... Now hand it over to Aquila.
id./param/region/r025.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2321: "What! You found the Goddess fruit? That's amazing... Now hand it over to Aquila.
id./param/region/r025.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1ffc: "Humans' gratitude becomes crystals called star aura, and a World Tree filled with it bears the Goddess fruit.
id./param/region/r025.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2334: "Humans' gratitude becomes crystals called star aura, and a World Tree filled with it bears the Goddess fruit.
id./param/region/r025.pack|npc_ie.bxon|200e: "Our angels' work is to gather star aura and make the Goddess fruit ripen...
id./param/region/r025.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2346: "Our angels' work is to gather star aura and make the Goddess fruit ripen...
id./param/region/r025.pack|npc_ie.bxon|201a: "Had the fruit been lost, decades of work would have been wasted. Thank you for finding it.
id./param/region/r025.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2352: "Had the fruit been lost, decades of work would have been wasted. Thank you for finding it.
id./param/region/r025.pack|npc_ie.bxon|203c: "We are people of a village called Etene. We lived peaceful, quiet lives on an island cut off from the outside world, but...
id./param/region/r025.pack|npc_ie.bxon|204a: "A fearsome monster army suddenly appeared and burned the village... and we lost our lives then.
id./param/region/r025.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2057: "A divine voice guided our souls: we have a mission, so choose a form from five races and be reborn...
id./param/region/r025.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2069: "Guided here, the divine voice suddenly stopped and a monster called the Rebirth King appeared.
id./param/region/r025.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2076: "The Rebirth King said he'd hinder our rebirth and made us able to be reborn only as monsters...
id./param/region/r025.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2083: "We can't be reborn as monsters like this. To clear the monsters in this room, could you find and defeat the Rebirth King?
id./param/region/r025.pack|npc_ie.bxon|209a: "Oh no... You're our only hope... What will we do...
id./param/region/r025.pack|npc_ie.bxon|20aa: "Thank you! The Rebirth King vanished in search of an instrument called the Silver harp.
id./param/region/r025.pack|npc_ie.bxon|20b5: "The Rebirth King looks like an old human. If you find a suspicious old man, that's him!
id./param/region/r025.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2108: "The Rebirth King looks like an old human. If you find a suspicious old man, that's him!
id./param/region/r025.pack|npc_ie.bxon|20c7: "Please be careful. Defeat the Rebirth King so we can be reborn properly!
id./param/region/r025.pack|npc_ie.bxon|20db: "Our souls were guided by a divine voice to be reborn here, choosing a form from five races, for a mission to fulfill.
id./param/region/r025.pack|npc_ie.bxon|20eb: "But the suddenly appearing Rebirth King said he'd hinder our rebirth and made us able to be reborn only as monsters.
id./param/region/r025.pack|npc_ie.bxon|20f9: "We can't be reborn as monsters! Please defeat the Rebirth King, who vanished seeking the Silver harp!
id./param/region/r025.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2126: "Thank you! The monsters here are gone because you defeated the Rebirth King, right?
id./param/region/r025.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2130: "Now we can be reborn as one of the five races as told and set out. Please accept our thanks!
id./param/region/r025.pack|npc_ie.bxon|213e: "What my remaining mission is, why monsters attacked our village... there's much I don't know yet.
id./param/region/r025.pack|npc_ie.bxon|216e: "What my remaining mission is, why monsters attacked our village... there's much I don't know yet.
id./param/region/r025.pack|npc_ie.bxon|214d: "But I've been given new life by the gods. I'll live fully for the other Etene folk too and fulfill my mission!
id./param/region/r025.pack|npc_ie.bxon|217d: "But I've been given new life by the gods. I'll live fully for the other Etene folk too and fulfill my mission!
id./param/region/r025.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2164: "Thanks to you, we can be reborn as one of the five races as told and set out.
id./param/region/r025.pack|npc_ie.bxon|21a7: "The big statues in the back are the gods of the five races we'll be reborn as.
id./param/region/r025.pack|npc_ie.bxon|21b5: "Starting from the one near me: Weddie, Dwarf, Elf, Pukulipo, and Ogre, they say.
id./param/region/r025.pack|npc_ie.bxon|21be: "I planned to be reborn as an Ogre and get strong... I refuse to become a Troll!
id./param/region/r025.pack|npc_ie.bxon|21ce: "At last the time to set out from here has come. Most villagers are gone, and I'm very anxious about the future.
id./param/region/r025.pack|npc_ie.bxon|21dc: "But I can never forgive that arrogant monster who burned the village and took everyone's lives so easily!
id./param/region/r025.pack|npc_ie.bxon|21e8: "No matter what form I'm reborn in, my heart will always be of the Etene people. I'll gain strength and avenge everyone!
id./param/region/r025.pack|npc_ie.bxon|21fe: "Hee hee hee. You'll be reborn as an Illusionist?
id./param/region/r025.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2204: "Illusionists beat Elves! If someone annoys you, you can torment them with spells as you please!
id./param/region/r025.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2217: "You'll be reborn as a Kobold, kobold?
id./param/region/r025.pack|npc_ie.bxon|221b: "I promise a more eccentric and dangerous life than a Dwarf, kobold!!
id./param/region/r025.pack|npc_ie.bxon|222b: "Whoa! You're going to be reborn as a Merman, such good taste, gyo!
id./param/region/r025.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2233: "Better than those half-fish people called Weddies, we Mermen have real tails and are handsome, gyo!
id./param/region/r025.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2246: "You're going to be reborn as a cute Buchuchunpa like us, hmm?
id./param/region/r025.pack|npc_ie.bxon|224d: "Your lips look good. You'll surely make a lovely Buchuchunpa, hon.
id./param/region/r025.pack|npc_ie.bxon|225e: "Ha ha! You decided to be reborn as a Troll?
id./param/region/r025.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2264: "If you want power, Troll beats Ogre! Only Trolls can smash everything without a thought with this club!
id./param/region/r025.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2366: The Turtle Deity quietly watches over the village.
id./param/region/r025.pack|npc_ie.bxon|237d: "You came. You must be {var:1}, who will rescue the abducted Turtle Deity.
id./param/region/r025.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2385: "Priestess Aba's oracle: a monster from another world will abduct the Turtle Deity, but you will resolve it...
id./param/region/r025.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2425: "Priestess Aba's oracle: a monster from another world will abduct the Turtle Deity, but you will resolve it...
id./param/region/r025.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2395: "The Turtle Deity is this village's guardian. Sometimes it gives oracles to priestess Aba and guides us.
id./param/region/r025.pack|npc_ie.bxon|23a3: "I didn't want to watch it being abducted, but the order was that it is {var:1}'s role so we must not interfere...
id./param/region/r025.pack|npc_ie.bxon|23af: "Please defeat the monster in the castle of another world, Necrogond, and bring the Turtle Deity back safely?
id./param/region/r025.pack|npc_ie.bxon|23c8: "Hmm... A refusal, just as the Turtle Deity's oracle said...
id./param/region/r025.pack|npc_ie.bxon|23ce: "But it said you'll surely accept even if you refuse, so don't worry. Talk to me again if you change your mind.
id./param/region/r025.pack|npc_ie.bxon|23e9: "Thank you. The oracle has never been wrong, but if anything happens to the Turtle Deity, it would be a catastrophe.
id./param/region/r025.pack|npc_ie.bxon|23f3: "I don't doubt the oracle, but I'm still worried. We'll help from the shadows. Take this with you.
id./param/region/r025.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2405: "With that Zoom stone, you can return to Etene Village in an instant.
id./param/region/r025.pack|npc_ie.bxon|240e: "After rescuing it, use the Zoom stone and return to this village together. Be careful.
id./param/region/r025.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2435: "Your role is to go to the castle of another world called Necrogond, defeat the monster, and bring the Turtle Deity back.
id./param/region/r025.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2441: "The oracle has never been wrong, but if anything happens to the Turtle Deity, it'd be a catastrophe. I worry.
id./param/region/r025.pack|npc_ie.bxon|244f: "Be careful, and after rescuing the Turtle Deity, use the Zoom stone I gave you and return to this village together.
id./param/region/r025.pack|npc_ie.bxon|246b: "Thank you. You fulfilled your role and brought the Turtle Deity back safely! Please accept Aba's gift.
id./param/region/r025.pack|npc_ie.bxon|247a: "In the last thousand years of our history, the Turtle Deity has never once left Etene Village.
id./param/region/r025.pack|npc_ie.bxon|24bb: "In the last thousand years of our history, the Turtle Deity has never once left Etene Village.
id./param/region/r025.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2487: "Everything went as the oracle said, but I was terribly uneasy. The villagers would have felt the same.
id./param/region/r025.pack|npc_ie.bxon|24c8: "Everything went as the oracle said, but I was terribly uneasy. The villagers would have felt the same.
id./param/region/r025.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2495: "I don't understand this anomaly, but I see Aba's kindness in taking everyone outside so they wouldn't worry.
id./param/region/r025.pack|npc_ie.bxon|24d6: "I don't understand this anomaly, but I see Aba's kindness in taking everyone outside so they wouldn't worry.
id./param/region/r025.pack|npc_ie.bxon|24a5: "I'll keep supporting young Aba, who serves the Turtle Deity, as best I can. That's my role...
id./param/region/r025.pack|npc_ie.bxon|24e6: "I'll keep supporting young Aba, who serves the Turtle Deity, as best I can. That's my role...
id./param/region/r025.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2512: "Etene Village is protected by the Turtle Deity's blessing and priestess Aba's barrier hiding us from monsters.
id./param/region/r025.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2521: "If a monster appeared and abducted the guardian Turtle Deity, the villagers would panic and cause a great uproar.
id./param/region/r025.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2530: "To avoid that, Aba left things to us and took the villagers outside before the monsters abducted the Turtle Deity.
id./param/region/r025.pack|npc_ie.bxon|253d: "Aba is young but very thoughtful. So please bring the Turtle Deity back safely before everyone returns.
id./param/region/r025.pack|npc_ie.bxon|254f: "The villagers will return soon. Everyone went out in a big group today and will end the day happily...
id./param/region/r025.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2560: "No one will notice the anomaly in the village. You protected the village's daily life. ...Thank you.
id./param/region/r025.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2578: "Oh...! Coming home at the wrong time, I run into such a serious scene.
id./param/region/r025.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2581: "...It's you!? The oracle person Chatsuka mentioned!
id./param/region/r025.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2588: "Hey, you're late! Hurry, hear everyone out and lend us your strength!
id./param/region/r025.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2598: "You may not understand, but the Turtle Deity is the whole world to us. ...It's that special.
id./param/region/r025.pack|npc_ie.bxon|25a3: "If anything happened to the Turtle Deity, all the people of Etene Village would die...
id./param/region/r025.pack|npc_ie.bxon|25ad: "Please! Bring our village's guardian, the Turtle Deity, back safely!
id./param/region/r025.pack|npc_ie.bxon|25ba: "Thank goodness... The Turtle Deity returned safely. It's thanks to you. Thank you.
id./param/region/r025.pack|npc_ie.bxon|25cc: "This big tree at the center of the angel realm is called the World Tree.
id./param/region/r025.pack|npc_ie.bxon|25d6: "Receiving star aura from humans and offering it to the World Tree, that's the angels' duty.
id./param/region/r025.pack|npc_ie.bxon|25e9: "Thud, thud! None shall pass here! By my master's order!
id./param/region/r025.pack|npc_ie.bxon|25f3: "A bomb rock's will is firm! Not a step will I move! Begone, begone, thud thud!

tm.「彼女は 明るくて 細かい気配りのできる\n すばらしい 宿屋人よ。: "She's a wonderful innkeeper, cheerful and attentive to detail.
tm.「リッカを もとに戻すには\n 王としての あり方を 説くような本を\n 読ませ: "To restore Rica, I think having her read a book that teaches what a king should be is the way.
tm.「待ってたわよ。\n 王としての あり方について 書かれた本を\n 見つけてくれ: "I've been waiting. You found a book on how a king should be, didn't you?
tm.「まだだったの……。\n そろそろ 見つけてくれるかと思ってたのに\n 意外に: "Not yet...? I thought you'd find it by now. It takes longer than I expected.
tm.「ありがとう！ 『王たる者』……\n まさに 私が求めていた 本だわ。\n さっ: "Thank you! "A True King"... exactly the book I wanted. Let's have Rica read it right away.
tm.「リッカが 宿王としての誇りを\n 取り戻してくれたから もう大丈夫よ。: "Rica regained her pride as innkeeper king, so she'll be fine now.
tm.「少女の笑顔を 取り戻すなんて\n ちいさな出来事かもしれないけど\n リッカの: "Bringing back a girl's smile may seem small, but Rica's is a special smile that cheers everyone.
tm.「あのまま 落ち込んでいたら\n リッカの友人は 心配のあまり\n 旅を 続けら: "If she'd stayed down, Rica's friend might have worried too much to continue the journey.
tm.「つまり…… あなたは リッカだけでなく\n そのまわりの たくさんの人を 元気: "So you cheered not only Rica but many people around her. Remember that. Thank you.
tm.「心配ですわ……。\n こんなこと 今までに\n 一度も ありませんでしたのに…: "I'm worried... This has never happened before...
tm.「リッカさまのことは 心配ですが\n わたくしまで落ち込んでいても\n 仕方がな: "I'm worried about Lady Rica, but it won't help if I'm down too. So then...
tm.「いらっしゃいませ。\n こちら 世界宿屋協会が お送りする\n スペシャルショ: "Welcome. This is Special Shopping brought to you by the World Inn Association.
tm.「……え？ カゼをひいた村人たちのために\n 最強のカゼぐすりを探している？\n: "...What? You're looking for the ultimate cold medicine for villagers with colds? Oh, that's terrible.
tm.「それでしたら 当店に おまかせください！\n お客さまの希望は 必ず かなえる: "Then leave it to us! Our motto is to always fulfill the customer's wish!
tm.「他ならぬ お客さまのために\n 最強のカゼぐすりを 作ってさしあげますわ！: "For you, dear customer, we'll make the ultimate cold medicine!
tm.「……ただ まことに 申しあげにくいのですが\n 最強のカゼぐすりを作るには 世: "...But I'm sorry to say that making it requires World Tree dew without fail.
tm.「というわけで お客さま。\n 世界樹のしずくを 持ってきてくださいますか？\n: "So, customer, could you bring us World Tree dew? Sorry for the trouble, thank you!
tm.「最強のカゼぐすりは 世界樹のしずくがあれば\n 作ってさしあげられるのですが…: "If we have World Tree dew, we can make the ultimate cold medicine, but we don't stock it now.
tm.「まあ それは 世界樹のしずく！\n これで 最強のカゼぐすりを作れますが\n: "Oh, that's World Tree dew! With this we can make the ultimate cold medicine. Will you hand it to me?
tm.「そうですか……。\n お役に立てず残念ですわ。\n 何かあれば お声をかけてく: "I see... Sorry I couldn't help. Call on me if you need anything.
tm.「たしかに 受け取りました。\n それでは 当店が責任を持って\n 最強のカゼぐ: "Received for certain. We'll take responsibility for making the ultimate cold medicine.
tm.「では 少々お待ちくださいませ。\n きっと 次に いらっしゃる頃には\n 完成: "Please wait a moment. By your next visit, it should be ready.
tm.「お客さま お待たせいたしました！\n 依頼のあった 最強のカゼぐすりが\n つ: "Thank you for waiting! The ultimate cold medicine you requested has finally arrived!
tm.「……それでは 最強のカゼぐすり\n ひとつ ２５００ゴールドになります。\n: "...That will be 2,500 gold for one ultimate cold medicine. Would you like to buy it?
tm.「わたくし個人の気持ちとしましては\n 無料で 差しあげたいところなのですが\n: "Personally I'd love to give it free, but we are a business... hee hee.
tm.{var:1}は ２５００ゴールドを渡し\n最強のカゼぐすりを 受け取った！: {var:1} paid 2,500 gold and⏎received the ultimate cold medicine!
tm.「ご利用ありがとうございました。\n またの お越しをお待ちしております！: "Thank you for your patronage. We look forward to seeing you again!
tm.最強のカゼぐすりを 手に入れた！\nカゼが流行っている サンタローズに戻って\n: Obtained the ultimate cold medicine!⏎Return to Santa Rosa, where colds are spreading,⏎and give it to Sancho!
tm.「……あら？ お客さま。\n 申し訳ありませんが それを買うには\n お金が足り: "...Oh? Customer, sorry, but it seems you don't have enough money to buy that.
tm.「お客さま 長らく お待たせいたしました。\n いよいよ お店の準備が ととのい: "Customer, sorry for the long wait. The shop is finally ready, so we're proud to open!
tm.「当店では 他の店にはない\n めずらしい品物を 取り扱っております。\n ぜひ: "Our shop carries rare items found nowhere else. Please take a look.
tm.「よかったですわ。\n リッカさまが 元気になられて。\n すべて あなたさまの: "I'm glad Lady Rica is well again. It's all thanks to you.
tm.「でも どうして リッカさまは 突然\n あのように 落ち込んでしまわれたのでし: "But why did Lady Rica suddenly slump like that?
tm.「リッカさまも 元気になられましたし\n これで わたくしも お仕事に\n 専念: "Lady Rica is well again, so I can focus on my work. So then...
tm.「リッカちゃん どうしちゃったんだろう。\n このところ ずっと暗い顔してるから: "What's wrong with Rica? She's looked gloomy lately, and it brings me down too.
tm.「うん？ どうしたんだ？\n ……なに 正体をあばけるような物について\n 何か: "Hm? What's wrong? ...What, do you know anything about something that can expose a fake?
tm.「あんた 妙な物を探してるんだな。\n ……そういえば 俺の知り合いが 旅先で\: "You're looking for a weird item. ...Come to think of it, an acquaintance said they found an Unmasking herb on their travels.
tm.「その 知り合いの魔法使いなら\n 見えざる魔神の道っていう 洞くつにいるぜ。\: "That mage friend is in a cave called the Unseen Demon's Path. They're probably around floor B3 now.
tm.「リッカちゃん いい笑顔だよなあ。\n あの顔を見てると 今日も １日がんばろう: "Rica has such a nice smile. Seeing it fills me with energy to do my best today.
tm.「宿王グランプリで 優勝したって 聞いたから\n わざわざ ここへ泊まりにきたの: "I came to stay here because I heard it won the Innkeeper King Grand Prix... The receptionist is so gloomy it's awful.
tm.「あのリッカって子 体調でも悪かったのかしら。\n これまでとは 違う キビキビ: "Was that girl Rica feeling unwell? She's brisk, different from before, and her considerate manner is pleasant to see.
tm.「あげた アバキ草は 私には必要ないわ。\n ホントに それを必要としてる人に\: "I don't need the Unmasking herb you gave. Give it to someone who truly needs it.
tm.「……うん 誰かを探してるのかい？\n なに 王子を探してるだって？: "...Hm, are you looking for someone? What, a prince?
tm.「ああ アイツのことかな。\n アイツなら 遠くに出ちまってるから\n 当分は: "Ah, that guy? He's far away and won't be back for a while.
tm.「ただ ボクの考えた 最強のドラゴン……\n 終焉竜エンドラゴンになれたらって\: "I just thought, if only I could become the strongest dragon I imagined, Endragon, the Dragon of Ending.
tm.「がっしりした身体に 大きなツバサ\n 長くて黒いツノに ３本の尻尾……: "A sturdy body, big wings, long black horns, three tails...
tm.「そんな強いドラゴンになって みんなを\n おどろかせたいって空想してたら 金色: "I daydreamed of becoming that dragon to surprise everyone, found a golden fruit... then I don't remember.
tm.「でも ちょっと調子に乗って\n 大暴れしちゃったような気がするよ……。\n 迷: "But I feel I got carried away and rampaged. If I caused trouble, sorry.
tm.「……あっ そうだ！\n もし 洞くつの奥に行くなら 気をつけて！\n なんだか: "...Oh, right! If you go deeper in the cave, be careful! I feel something really dangerous.
tm.「うーむ。どう考えても おかしい……。\n 手にしていた 女神の果実が消えるなん: "Hmm. This is utterly strange... The Goddess fruit I held vanished... What a pickle. What should I do?
tm.「君は……まさか 人間？\n なぜ 人間が こんな所に……。: "You... can't be human? Why is a human in a place like this...
tm.「いや 待て。人間だったら\n 私の姿が 見えるはずがない……。\n 私は 夢で: "No, wait. If you were human, you couldn't see me... Am I dreaming?
tm.「それにしても\n どうして こんな所にいる。\n 私に 何か用か？: "Still, why are you here? Do you need something from me?
tm.「……変なヤツだな。\n ここは 人間が 気安く来ていい場所ではない。\n 用が: "...Strange fellow. This is no place for a human to wander in. If you have no business, go home.
tm.「私の こまりごとを 解決しにきた？\n ははは！ そうか。\n 私を からかっ: "You came to solve my problem? Ha ha! I see. You're teasing me.
tm.「まあいい。せっかくだから 頼んでみよう。\n 女神の果実という 金色の果実が: "Well, why not. Let me ask you. A golden fruit called the Goddess fruit suddenly vanished from my hand.
tm.「私なりに 気配を探ってみたのだが\n 見えざる魔神という 言葉が浮かんだだけで: "I probed for traces, but only the words 'unseen fiend' surfaced, and I don't know what they mean.
tm.「ほとんど 手がかりなしという状況だが\n それでも探せると言うなら 探してみて: "I have almost no clues, but if you say you can search, please try! If you find it, I'll reward you well!
tm.「女神の果実という 金色の果実が ひとつ\n 私の手から 突然 消えてしまったの: "A golden fruit called the Goddess fruit suddenly vanished from my hand. Such a disappearance is no ordinary matter.
tm.「だが 私が管理している間に 消えたのだから\n 私の責任だ……。女神の果実は: "But it vanished under my watch, so it's my responsibility. The Goddess fruit is a treasure of the angel realm. I must find it!
tm.「女神の果実の 気配を探ったところ\n 見えざる魔神という 言葉が浮かんだ。: "When I probed for the Goddess fruit's traces, the words 'unseen fiend' surfaced.
tm.「それが 何を示すかまでは わからないが\n 女神の果実の行方に 関係する言葉な: "I don't know what it means, but it must relate to the fruit's whereabouts. Please look into the unseen fiend too!
tm.「この感じ……\n もしかして 女神の果実が 見つかったのか？: "This feeling... Did you find the Goddess fruit?
tm.「そうか まだか……。\n 女神の果実の気配を\n 感じたような 気がしたのだが: "I see, not yet... I thought I felt the Goddess fruit's presence...
tm.「ありがとう！\n まさか 人間が 天使の私を助けてくれるとは！\n さあ お礼: "Thank you! To think a human would help an angel like me! Here, take your reward.
tm.「ほう？ 地上に落ちた 女神の果実が\n スライムを 凶暴なドラゴンに 変えたと: "Oh? The Goddess fruit that fell to the earth turned a Slime into a fierce dragon? That's certainly possible.
tm.「女神の果実には 計り知れないチカラが\n 秘められているのだ。だから 魔物たち: "The Goddess fruit holds immeasurable power. That's why we guard it strictly so monsters can't get it, but...
tm.「今回の 女神の果実の消え方は\n あまりに突然で 防ぎようがなかった……。: "This disappearance was too sudden to prevent...
tm.「もしかしたら 私のチカラを超える\n 何者かの 仕業だったのかもしれない。\n: "Perhaps it was the work of someone beyond my power. If you keep traveling, be careful too.
tm.「女神の果実には\n 食べた者の 願いをかなえるという\n 計り知れないチカラが: "The Goddess fruit holds immeasurable power to grant the wish of whoever eats it.
tm.「だから 魔物たちの手に 渡らないよう\n 厳重に管理しているのだが……今回の消: "We guard it strictly from monsters, but this disappearance was too sudden to prevent...
tm.「そういえば……君は 私の弟子に似ているな。\n ウォルロ村の守護天使を 継がせ: "You resemble my apprentice, who'll inherit Wallo Village's guardian angel post. He's earnest and upright too.
tm.「おどろいた……。\n 人間が この天使界に 来るなんて……。\n しかも 私の: "I'm surprised... A human coming to the angel realm. And you seem able to see me.
tm.「やはり 何かが 起きているようだ。\n 異変とともに現れた 人間よ。\n イザ: "Something is happening after all. Human who appeared with the anomaly, please help Aquila.
tm.「……どうした？\n 何か 話がありそうだな。ふむ……。\n 天使のきつけ薬を: "...What is it? You seem to have something to say. Hmm... Do I know angel's smelling salts, you ask?
tm.「もちろんだ。\n 魔物が いたずらをして\n 人々の正気を失わせるのは よくあ: "Of course. It's common for monsters to play pranks and make people lose their senses.
tm.「それを いつでも治せるように\n 天使なら 誰でも持っている 薬だが……\n: "Every angel carries medicine to cure that anytime... What about it?
tm.{var:1}は ラヴィエルに\n正気を失ったように\n結婚に反対する人たちのこ: {var:1} told Ladiel about⏎people opposing a marriage⏎as if they'd lost their senses.
tm.「なるほど……。キミは 薬を探しにきたのか。\n 急に 人が変わったということな: "I see. You came looking for the medicine. If people changed suddenly, this medicine may indeed be needed.
tm.「持っていけ。それ１本で\n 町ひとつ分くらいの人たちを治せるぞ。: "Take it. One bottle can cure about a town's worth of people.
tm.天使のきつけ薬を 手に入れた！\n勇者の実家にいる女性に 届けよう！: Obtained angel's smelling salts!⏎Deliver them to the woman at the hero's home!
tm.「女神の果実には 食べた者の願いを\n かなえるチカラがあるんだ。\n よからぬ: "The Goddess fruit has the power to grant the eater's wish. In the wrong hands, it'd be disastrous.
tm.「……そういえば 地上にある洞くつに 突然\n おそろしい竜が現れたという 情報: "...Come to think of it, there was word that a fearsome dragon suddenly appeared in a cave on earth.
tm.「イザヤールがなくした 女神の果実と\n 関係があるかもしれない。もし 地上の洞: "It may relate to the Goddess fruit Aquila lost. If you can go to that cave on earth, it may be worth a visit.
tm.「なんと！ 女神の果実を 見つけたと言うのか？\n それは すごいな……。\n: "What! You found the Goddess fruit? That's amazing... Now hand it over to Aquila.
tm.「人間たちの感謝は 星のオーラという結晶になり\n 星のオーラで満たされた 世界: "Humans' gratitude becomes crystals called star aura, and a World Tree filled with it bears the Goddess fruit.
tm.「私たち天使の仕事は 星のオーラを集め\n 女神の果実を 実らせること……。: "Our angels' work is to gather star aura and make the Goddess fruit ripen...
tm.「あのまま 女神の果実が 失われていれば\n 何十年分もの はたらきが ムダにな: "Had the fruit been lost, decades of work would have been wasted. Thank you for finding it.
tm.「ボクたちは エテーネという村の民です。\n 外界から隔絶された島で 平和で\n: "We are people of a village called Etene. We lived peaceful, quiet lives on an island cut off from the outside world, but...
tm.「おそろしい魔物たちの軍勢が\n 突然現れ 村を焼きはらい……\n ボクたちは: "A fearsome monster army suddenly appeared and burned the village... and we lost our lives then.
tm.「そんなボクたちの魂を導いたのは 神の声です。\n その魂には まだ 果たすべき: "A divine voice guided our souls: we have a mission, so choose a form from five races and be reborn...
tm.「そう言われ ここに導かれてきたのですが\n いきなり 神の声が途絶え\n 転生: "Guided here, the divine voice suddenly stopped and a monster called the Rebirth King appeared.
tm.「転生大王は ボクたちの\n 生まれ変わりを ジャマしてやると言い\n 魔物にし: "The Rebirth King said he'd hinder our rebirth and made us able to be reborn only as monsters...
tm.「このまま 魔物に転生するなんて できません。\n この部屋にいる魔物たちを消し: "We can't be reborn as monsters like this. To clear the monsters in this room, could you find and defeat the Rebirth King?
tm.「そんな……。\n あなただけが 頼りなのに……\n ボクたちは これから どう: "Oh no... You're our only hope... What will we do...
